depth_history.edit_summary: No valid single edit can defeat all surviving models without changing the core problem: the tree structure is mathematically forced by the immutable n-1 edge count plus the sufficiency guarantee. A meaningful defeat would require allowing a non-tree catalog, such as m greater than n-1, which is prohibited.
